AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#369 @ 3252ec79cd9ab1f28165a1913d8ae3096b590d4a — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/2

Independent T4 delta, **AUD-SOL-H7-120, agent 120**. Full FIX ROUND 1 production/test delta and the H4-to-H7 auth/state composition reviewed; 1,205 changed lines remains below the 1,500 new-piece limit. [Candidate repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5985690624).

### Prior finding disposition

**B-369-1 closes for the reported completed-signOut/single-AsyncStorage-outage counterexample.** SecureStore authority deletion/replacement makes the retained session/grant insufficient; the original actual-signOut mutation-outage, missing/unreadable authority, delete-fallback and same-consent-restart controls pass independently. **B-362-8/9 and the overlapping failed-grant C-362-13 remainder close in the H1-H7 composition**, not at standalone H4: both original getAllKeys/removeMany restart cases, both other-cleanup-rejection drains, held-native/queued-grant controls and committed-sequence rollback pass. [Independent 30-suite replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341997614), [Prior findings](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5985235823).

### B-369-2 — An in-flight Connect recreates durable consent after the immediate revocation

`src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:184-188,214-229,325-331`. The epoch is checked only before entering the asynchronous grant callback. Hold a **pre-signOut** Connect at either (1) its consent-session read or (2) a started native authority-creation write; start actual signOut and prove the immediate SecureStore revocation succeeded; resume that already-started Connect. It creates/recreates a new authority and durably commits a matching grant. Hold **only the native grant's JS acknowledgement** after that commit: the second revocation is still behind it in the queue. At that permitted process-exit boundary, fresh JS modules retaining the same two stores execute actual refresh for the same account/server-connected row **without another Connect** and return `{kind: imported, syncCalls: 1}`, expected `{kind: not_authorized, syncCalls: 0}`, in both schedules. [Broad exact-candidate proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341997614), [Narrow corroboration after actual auth-token deletion](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37342514128).

The narrow corroboration additionally waits for the synthetic Supabase access token to be removed by actual signOut before taking the restart snapshot. No storage operation rejects. Another account remains unauthorized; the old Connect rejects on its stopped fence; releasing its native acknowledgement lets signOut finish and the full-drain restart control becomes unauthorized. Drivers always release/drain the old-run work before asserting. This is **interrupted sign-out**, not completed-signOut revival, hardware reproduction, real health data or a network upload. [Corroborating two schedules and controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37342514128).

**Minimal fix rule:** re-check the captured sign-out epoch/session after every awaited consent-session/authority operation, before creating an authority and immediately before publishing the native grant, or use an equivalent durable protocol that a stale pre-signOut writer cannot rebind to. A second queued revocation repairs uninterrupted completion but cannot supply crash durability. Preserve same-consent restart authorization, drain/rejection recovery, completed single-store-outage revocation, newer-grant Disconnect safety and failed-grant rollback. Add the two schedules to the existing H7 fixture (do not duplicate the full 446-line probe suite into this 1,205-line PR); keep the 1,500 ceiling. [Replayable failing invariants](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37342514128).

### Retained optional findings

- **C-369-2:** `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:386-416`, outside this round's changed lines: failed prefix removal plus a new explicit Connect can retain old completed-through/page-token progress. Bind progress to the consent session or discard stale-session progress; preserve same-session resume. No consent bypass is claimed from progress alone. [Prior documentation probe/disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5985494019).
- **C-369-3:** `src/services/authActions.ts:384,460-462`, pre-existing/outside this diff: an earlier throwing dependency may prevent logout, although H7 now drains health correctly before propagating rejection. Ticket a resilient auth-cleanup boundary with truthful recovery; do not broaden this freeze repair. [Prior disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5985494019).

### Evidence, CI and recommended default

Independent broad execution `633935a68f5b60aeb788e6b933f81dc303f2b8dd` = exact candidate + test-only commits + lane: **2 new invariant failures / 439 passing tests**, 29/30 suites pass, including deletion, native-order, session/transport, supported Connect UI and both native-sync services. Narrow execution `a3adf93693a6d5174654a71ff463de7caa697fa9` = same candidate + refined test-only driver + lane: **2 invariant failures / 22 passing controls**. All candidate production and existing test blobs are unchanged. Two earlier driver versions timed out because a spy targeted an import namespace wrapper; those runs are preserved and are **not defect evidence**. [Broad execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341997614), [Narrow execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37342514128).

G09 reuse is limited to prior-reviewed unchanged H1-H6/H7 boundaries; current repair lines and native-store interleavings were audited independently, not adopted from the other lens. Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test is green; Analyze is absent on the stacked base, not successful. **Default: repair B-369-2 and obtain fresh dual exact-head H7 verdicts; hold H1-H7 landing, retain main-based required checks, ticket C-369-2/3, and preserve separate authorized native/device/privacy/flag gates.** No build, deployment or production acceptance claim. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37244309360/job/111559038041).
